identity.title: observe ring-shaped producer port into internal_diagnostics: codes, counters and opaque ids only, closed event-code mapping

specification_anchor_refs.verbatim: [STU-ARC-026] DIAGNOSTIC RING PRODUCER. The observe asset crate MUST expose a ring-shaped producer port into the `internal_diagnostics` ring (Section 5.8) that carries only an event code, counters and opaque ids, never text, and MUST map Studio terminal outcomes to the closed `internal_diagnostics` event-code set (`DiagEventCode` in the current implementation). DECLARED GAP, not settled here: the closed allowlist table mapping observe outcomes to those codes, the ring's per-event size and per-producer drop accounting for many producers, and module-identity and correlation fields on the diagnostic event are owned by Section 5.8.

risks.risk: Text (paths, prompts, document content) leaks into the diagnostic ring
risks.mitigation: The producer type admits no string payload; a ring scan finds no text

risks.risk: An observe outcome maps to a code outside the closed set or to no code
risks.mitigation: Exhaustive mapping test over every terminal outcome; the allowlist table itself stays a declared Section 5.8 gap
